courses.title: Design Systems at Scale
courses.description: By the end of Design Systems at Scale, you'll be able to apply design systems confidently in Product Designer work, with a working sense of where database basics fits alongside it. The course moves from core design systems technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at database basics woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying design systems to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing design systems through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to database basics
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Accessibility for Practitioners
courses.description: Accessibility for Practitioners is a focused course on accessibility for people already working toward a Product Designer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying accessibility on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying accessibility to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing accessibility through guided exercises
Building a short accessibility exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: Animation for Interfaces Basics is a short introduction to animation for interfaces for people moving toward a Product Designer role. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if animation for interfaces is new to you.

alternates.title: Design Systems Essentials
alternates.description: Design Systems Essentials walks you through the basics of design systems, built for people new to Product Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of design systems, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying design systems to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing design systems through guided exercises
Building a short design systems exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Design Systems Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Design Systems Techniques goes beyond the basics of design systems, for people already working toward a Product Designer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in design systems and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying design systems to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing design systems through guided exercises
Building a short design systems exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
